changes.description: A library to support complex camera ISPs
changes.note: It improves output with IMX471 sensor drivers, which can be found on the Lenovo X9 and X1 Gen14. The follow-up issue points to horizontal noise, and the issue can be found at the following URL. https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2502786. 0.7.2 mitigated the horizontal noise. Moreover, the improvement of SoftISP dramatically improved the image AWB when running on IPU7 and IMX471. The image won't be green and dark one.
